يتعاقل (form VI)
# يَتَعَاقَلُ (yataʕāqalu) /ja.ta.ʕaː.qa.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاقَلَ (taʕāqala)
# يَتَعَاقَلَ (yataʕāqala) /ja.ta.ʕaː.qa.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاقَلَ (taʕāqala)
# يَتَعَاقَلْ (yataʕāqal) /ja.ta.ʕaː.qal/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاقَلَ (taʕāqala)
